differences: The only visible difference is the color of the "Edit" label: in A23D it is neutral gray/white matching "Cancel"; in 6A2E it is blue/purple, visually distinct from "Cancel". Layout, spacing, text content, header, field rows, footer metadata, and the orange "送る" button are identical in both.
notes: A23D keeps only one colored action (送る) for cleaner primary emphasis; 6A2E's colored Edit aids discoverability of that control but slightly dilutes the single-accent hierarchy.
